answer: Sybil Resistant Mirror Ledger employs a glacier model where identity duplication becomes self-revealing as each falcon-shaped node must mirror prior actions across epochs, and an attacker pays a concrete per-identity cost of irreversible reputation loss. The system ensures that any attempt to create multiple identities exposes itself through consistent behavioral patterns. This mechanism maintains the same per-identity cost while reinforcing the integrity of the ledger through mirrored actions. The glacier model thus provides a robust framework for preventing identity fraud.
